subject: Holiday pay policy v3 is live – v2 retired
body: Hi all, v3 of the BE double holiday pay policy is now the reference. v2 (85%) is retired, please stop using it. The old file might still be floating around in the archive folder.

subject: RE: holiday pay timing
body: Confirming our company agreement: double holiday pay is advanced to the April payroll for all employees. Please keep applying this every year.

subject: Handover: you are taking over Jens's portfolio from October
body: Arne, you'll inherit Jens's 12 clients including Brouwerij Van de Leie. Jens leaves on 15 October. Please use the handover checklist and book time with him.
